tei:div.tei:p: "$ (501)༄༅// bde mchog snyan brgyud kyi rdzogs rim steng sgo rnam par grol ba'i chos drug gi khrid yig bzhugs so/// /

(502)༄༅// na mo gu ru de ba ḍā ki nī// gsang dbang dang 'brel ba steng sgo rnam par grol ba'i lam la drug ste// gtum mo bde drod rang 'bar lam gyi gzhung shing dang*// sgyu lus chos brgyad rang grol dang*// rmi lam 'khrul pa rang sangs dang*// 'od gsal ma rig mun bral dang*// 'pho ba gser 'gyur gyi rtsi dang*// grong 'jug sprul lpags 'dor byed do// dang po la lnga ste/ gtum mo'i dbye ba dang*/ byed las dang*/ chos mtshungs dpe dang sbyar ba dang*/ rgyu mtshan dang*/ spar thabs so// dang po la bzhi ste/ phyi dang*/ nang dang*/ gsang ba dang*/ de kho na nyid kyi gtum mo'o// byed las ni/ phyi'i gtum mos gdon stong phrag brgyad cu 'joms/ nang gi gtum mos nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi 'joms/ gsang ba'i gtum mos nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong 'joms/ de kho na nyid kyi gtum mos rang la yod pa'i lhan skyes kyi ye shes ngo sprod pa'o// chos mtshungs dpe dang sbyar ba ni/ phyi'i gtum mo me dang chos mtshungs te/ me'i nang du shing gcig bskyur kyang sreg la/ brgya bsgyur kyang sreg /de bzhin du gdon gcig gnod kyang sreg la/ brgya (503)gnod kyang sreg go /nang gi gtum mo sman dang chos mtshungs te/ sman pa mkhas pas sman btang na nad sel ba bzhin gtum mo bsgoms pas nad sel ba'o// gsang ba'i gtum mo seng ge dang chos mtshungs te/ seng ges ri dwags thams cad zil gyis mnan pa bzhin du/ gtum mo bsgoms pas nyon mongs pa thams cad zil gyis mnan pa'o// de kho na nyid kyi gtum mo me long dang mtshungs te/ me long g.ya' dag pa la bltas na rang gi bzhin mthong ba bzhin du/ gtum mo bsgoms pas rang gi sangs rgyas kyi ye shes gsal lam me mthong nas a pa de ru 'dug pa la sngar ngo ma shes 'dug snyam pa cig 'byung ba'o/ rgyu mtshan ni/ nges tshig yin te/ gtum bya ba ni spang bya 'joms pa la zer te/

dper na go mtshon thogs pa'i dpa' bo gcig gis sdar ma'i dmag dpung 'joms pa bzhin nyon mongs rnam rtog gdon bgegs 'joms pa la dpa' zhing gtum pas na gtum zhes bya/ mo zhes bya ba ni yon tan bskyed pa la zer te/ dper na dpal che ba'i bu mo mdzes ma cig la khye'u phun sum tshogs pa cig skyes na 'jig (504)rten gyi bde 'bras skyed pa bzhin mchog thun mong thams cad 'di las bskyed pas mo zhes bya'o// grangs nges ni// bzhir nges te de bas nyung na mi 'du ste/ phyi'i med na gdon mi sel/ nang gi med na nad mi sel/ gsang ba'i med na nyon mongs mi chom/ de kho na nyid med na ye shes mi 'phrod/ de bas mang na don med de/ gdon bzhi/ nad bzhi/ nyon mongs pa bzhi/ ye shes bzhi ngo 'phrod nas/ khur bor sangs rgyas pa yin te/ dper na chur thon pa la gru mi dgos pa bzhin/ gtum mo rang yang bsgom mi dgos so// gtum mo'i sbar thabs la gsum ste/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum mo// sbyor ba la gnad bzhi las/ gsol 'debs byin rlabs kyi gnad/ gegs sel bsnyen pa'i gnad/ mthun sbyor rkyen gyi gnad/ gsang ba dam tshig gi gnad do// dang po ni/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgoms la 'dir snyan brgyud byin rlabs kyi lam/ byin rlabs mos gus gsol 'debs kyi lam yin pas gsol ba snying gi dkyil/ rkang gi khong*/ rus pa'i gding nas mchi ma phyung la/ bde drod ye shes kyi me sbar du gsol/ zhes gsol ba drag tu gdab bo// gnyis pa gegs sel bsnyen pa'i gnad la/ gdon dang*/ nad dang*/ nyon mongs pa gsum gyis gegs byas nas gtum mo ngo sprod du mi ster bas bcom ldan 'das ma'i bsnyen pa sum 'bum bzhi khri btang*/ des gegs las grol nas byin rlabs kyis bde drod 'byung ngo*// gsum pa mthun sbyor rkyen gyi gnad la bdun te/ dang po 'dug pa gnas kyi gnad ni nyin mo skye bo'i 'du 'dzis dben/

mtshan mo dgra rkun gyi mel tshes dben/ 'cho ba dang chu shing bsgrub sla ba'o// gnyis pa mthun pa grogs kyi gnad ni/ dam tshig dang sdom pa srung ba/ lta spyod dang bla ma gcig pa'o// gsum pa bza' ba zas kyi gnad ni/ (505)tshad pa shas che na bsil ba bsten/ grang ba shas che na drod bcud bsten/ rgyun du bcud can nyung ba dang*/ bdud rtsi lnga la'ang bsten par bya'o/ bzhi pa bgo ba gos kyi gnad ni/ dro yang gcer bu mi bya/ grang yang skyi chags mi bgo /mkha' 'gro mnyes byed ras dgos dang mi 'bral ba brtson 'grus kyi lcag yin pas bsgrub par bya/ lnga pa bde ba mal gyi gnad ni/ mal sgom thag dang mnyam pa/ mgo sngas la mi 'jog pa'o// drug pa mi 'bral ba pus 'khyud kyi gnad ni/ nyis bltabs la khru gang sor bzhi pa/ skyes pas rnal 'byor mar bsgoms la bstim/ bud med kyis he ru kar bsgom/ 'jug dus su yab yum khril gyis 'khril bar bsam/ 'gom yug mi gtang*/ bdun pa ngal dub med par spyod pa'i lam ni/ 'gro 'dug las khur/ mchod rgyug /las ngal dub rdul thon pa mi bya/ ku co smra dgod rdo brdeg mi bya/ bzhi pa gsang ba dam tshig gi gnad ni/ spyir snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa/ sgos snyan brgyud kyi dmigs pa/ 'khrul 'khor rlung gi gnad/ nyams myong du ba la sogs pa'i rtags rnams gsang ngo*// dngos gzhi la gnad rnam pa lnga las/ nges pa dus kyi gnad dang*/ skyon bral lus kyi gnad dang*/ gnas pa rtsa'i gnad dang*/ g.yo ba rlung gi gnad dang*/ dmigs pa yul gyi gnad do/ dang po la gnyis las/ sgom pa dus kyi gnad ni/ 'grangs ches pa dang*/ ltog chas pa'i dus su bsgoms pa na/ rtsa 'chang ba dang*/ rlung khyer ba'i skyon yod pas mi bsgom/ nam phyed nas rlung 'dre rtsar shor nas 'dre snang 'byung bas mi bsgom/ rtog pa sna tshogs 'phro ba'i dus su sems kyi rgyal po sprul bar gnas pas de dus bsgom/

nam phyed 'das nas nam langs kyi bar bad kan cha'i (506)dus yin pas gtum mo'i me bsgoms pas 'byung ba snyoms// rtsa sbubs thams cad stong par yod pas rlung gis thig le rtsa nang du phul/ lus la khrems pas rtsa rlung byang chub sems su gyur pas bogs cher 'byung*/ rgyun du thun bzhir bsgom mo// khyad par gyi dus gnad zhal las shes/ gnyis pa nyams myong dus kyi gnad la gsum ste/ dang po gtum mo sdug bsngal gyi dus su sdug bsngal bzod par bya ba ni/ rtsa zug rlung zug thig le'i zug dang*/ mgo dang ro stod na ba dang*/ 'khru skyug la sogs ci rigs pa 'byung*/ gtum mo sgom pa la ngal dub dang skyo ba'i nyams 'char/ des na sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i don du gtum mo bsgom mi nus na/ ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal myong du ci tsug byed snyam du bsams la/ shi ma shi med par bsgom/ bar du btang snyoms kyi dus su sos dal spangs nas bsgom pa ni/ sngar gyi na tsha dang sdug bsngal rnams zhi/ bde drod bag tsam byung dus des chog snyam du sos dal du mi sdod par le lo med par brtson 'grus bskyed la drod de rgyu mtshan du byas la bsgom/ tha ma ngo 'phrod nas de'i dus su yengs med du bsgom pa ni/ phyi ru drod mi 'dod kyang 'byung*/ nang du bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin skyes/ de la du ba la sogs pa'i rtags sna re tsam mthong dus des yid tshim nas ma bsgoms na/ yon tan gong ma la bar du gcod pa'i bdud zhugs pa yin pas yengs pa med par bsgom mo/ gnyis pa skyon bral lus kyi gnad ni/ lus gnad chos bdun dang ldan pa ste/ rkang pa rdo rje skyil krung byas pas drod shugs kyis skye ba yin/ lag pa gnyis lte 'og sor bzhir mnyam bzhag dam du byas pas rtsa kha bye/ bde ba skye/ rgal tshigs drang por bsrangs pas rlung rang sar gnad du chud pa yin/ mgrin pa lcags kyu ltar bkug pas rba rlabs kyi rtsa non nas mi rtog pa skye ba yin/

(507)dpung pa rgod gshog ltar brkyangs pas rlung nad chung ba yin/ mig sna rtser bltas pas dmigs pa gsal ba yin/ lus sems li ri ltar li ri ni rtsa dras ma ste// de'i thag bzo pa dus grim por ma bsgrims par lhod na zhig 'gro ba ltar/ gtum mo bsgom pa'i skabs lus gnad dang dmigs gnad rtse gcig tu ma bsgrims na nyams len kha 'byams drod rtags skye ba'i dus mi yong bas shin tu bsgrim dgos pa'i don no// mchan/ 'khrul 'khor 'di rnams la skyon 'di rnams bsal dgos te// mgo bo rgus na tshig pa za// mig mi gsal/ gnyid che/ shes pa nyog ro stod dgyes pas shes pa 'phyo/ rtog pa 'phro/ ro stod gzer cing na/ ro stod rgus pas shug ring 'byin/ nyams mi dga'/ snying rlung 'byung*/ ro stod brgyangs nas na/ g.yas su yo na dmigs pa mi zin/ 'gro 'dod/ nor la gzan/ g.yon du yo na 'dod sred che/ tshe thung*/ 'khor mi 'du/ don mi 'grub/ tshang ra stan du bting na/ thig le 'dzag mkhal nad 'jug le lo che/ nyams ngan no// des na rtag tu lus gnad bsrangs te 'dug par bya te/ de'ang rnam snang gi chos bdun no/ yang na tsog bur rkang pa re mig ltar bsnol ba la lham sgrog ske rags 'ching pa nas sgom thag bsdams pas rlung zug chung*/ lus gnad dam/ drod skye ba myur ba yin/ gzhan snga ma bzhin no/ yang bol gong 'gal bu ltar brtsegs/ lag pa sgom thag ltar bsdam/ 'di yang drod myur ro// gzhan yang gtum mo'i 'khrul 'khor bco brgyad la sogs pa rim gyis sbyang bar bya'o// gsum pa gnas pa rtsa'i gnad ni/ lus la rtsa rgyas par phye na ba spu'i grangs dang mnyam/ de bsdu na nyi khri chig stong*/ de bsdu na stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis/ de bsdu na rtsa (508)gsum 'khor lo bzhi/ de bsdu na dhū di/ lā la/ rā sa gsum/ de bsdu na dhū ti gcig pu la 'dus so// rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi'i gnas tshul ni/

lus kyi khong drang por dhū ti srog shing gi tshul du gnas te/ yar sna tshangs bug la zug pa pha las thob pa'i thig le dkar po'i dwangs ma ham̐ mgo mthur du bstan pa la thug pa/ mar sne skyes pa'i gsang ba'i rdo rje yin pas thig le dkar po 'bab/ bud med kyi dhū ti'i mar sne lte 'og sor bzhi nas mdud pa nyis sbrag yod pas thig le dkar po mi 'bab/ dhū ti mtshan nyid bzhi ldan te/ pad+ma'i snal ma ltar phra ba/ srab ba'i don min/ mchan/ chu shing gi sdong po ltar drang ba/ rgya skyegs kyi me tog ltar dmar ba/ til gyi mar me ltar gsal ba'o// bsgom dus dhū ti'i mar sna gsang gnas lte 'og sor bzhi na/ sum mdor/ chos 'byung gru gsum kha gyen du bstan pa'i nang na ma las thob pa'i thig le dmar po'i dwangs ma rtsa bya rog gdong can la a thung zug par bsgon/ ham̐ gis bde ba bskyed/ a thung gi drod bskyed pa'o// rtsa g.yas rā sa na kha dog dmar la dkar ba'i mdangs can/ rtsa g.yon lā la nā dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can/ gnyis ka'i yar sna sna bug gnyis su zug /smin mtshams nas ltag par 'khyogs nas dhū ti'i nang gshibs pa g.yas pa'i mar sna skyes ba la lte 'og sor bzhi na mdud par yod pas thig le dmar po de man chad la mi 'bab/ bud med kyi mar sna bu snod chags pas rtsa g.yas pa'i rtsa sna pad+ma yin pas thig le dmar po dus la 'bab pa'o// pho mo gnyis ka'i rtsa g.yon nas dri chu 'bab pa'o// byed las ni/ rtsa g.yas pa nyi ma me'i rang bzhin zhe sdang skyed/ g.yon pa zla ba chu'i rang bzhin 'dod chags skyed/ dbu ma dhū ti mun pa'i rang bzhin gti mug skyed/ bsgom dus dhū ti mda' smyug tsam/ rtsa g.yas g.yon gro sog tsam mar sna lte 'og sor (509)bzhi ru dhū ti la zug pa bsgom/ 'khor lo bzhi ni/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab drug tu rtsa bzhi/ de la bsten nas bde drod bskyed/

snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab brgyad/ de la brten nas 'od gsal zin/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab bcu drug /de la brten nas rmi lam 'byongs/ spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab sum cu so gnyis/ de la brten nas zag med bskyed/ lte ba sprul sku'i sa bon rtsa yig a/ snying gar chos sku'i sa bon hūm̐/ mgrin par longs sku'i sa bon oṃ/ spyi bor ngo bo nyid kyi sku thob pa'i sa bon ham̐ ye nas gnas/ sgom dus su 'khor lo bzhi gdugs brtsegs pa'i nang ltar rtsa'i drwa mig shig ge ba/ rtsa rnams mi sgom pa'i dus su kha dog ser po/ sgom dus su dmar po/ dkyil na rtsa gsum gdugs kyi yu ba ltar yod par bsgom mo// bzhi pa g.yo ba rlung gi gnad la gsum ste/ steng rang byung ye shes su sbar nas steng rlung gi las gcig ston/ 'og zag med bde chen du sbar nas 'og sgo'i bcu gcig ston par 'khor 'das rgyun gcod du sbar nas rtsa rlung gi chings gcig ston pa'o// dang po rlung sgom pa la rlung gi gnas tshul shes par bya ba ni/ mi rgan po dang*/ byis pa ma yin pa dar ma nad med pa la/ nyin zhag gcig la rlung 'byung 'jug gnas gsum gcig tu dril ba nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'o// de'ang 'byung ba lnga'i rlung gis phye na/ lnga po re re la stong phrag bzhi dang sum brgya nyi shu nyi shu rgyu/ de bsdu na rtsa ba'i rlung lnga/ yan lag gi rlung lnga ste bcu ru 'dus/ de srog rtsol gnyis su 'dus/ phyi ru rgyu ba rnam rtog skyed pas rtsol ba zhes bya/ nang du 'jug pa tshe dpal skyed pas srog ces bya'o/ steng rang byung ye shes su sngar nas steng rlung gi las cig ston/ ces pa ni/ thog mar yan lag dgus rlung skyon sbyang ste/ g.yas su gsum/ (510)g.yon du gsum/ dbus su gsum drag la ring bar 'bud/ nad gdon nyon mongs pa thams cad dud pa ltar thon par bsam/

rngub dus 'dzam bu'i gling gi tshe dang dpal thams cad 'od zer gyi tshul du 'dus nas rang la thim pas bkrag mdangs su gyur par bsam/ de nas drag rlung sbyang ba ni/ rlung byed pa gcig la bya ba khru gang tsam nas drag por rngub nas steng rlung chil gyis mnan pas/ lā la rā sa gnyis nas rgyu ma pus btab pa bzhin song nas rlung sems dhū ti nang du khrog song bar dmigs la/ rlung ci tsam thub thub gzung*/ mi thub pa dang g.yas g.yon dbus dang gsum du brdig /rlung yang bskyar cing rngub la brtsegs par bya/ yang mgo dgug bya/ ro stod sing bya/ rlung chil te mnan no// de mi thub par 'dug snyam pa dang*/ ltag pa cung dgye tsam byas la/ sangs tser btang*/ rlung zhabs dwangs ma bag tsam yod pa la rngub nas yang sngar bzhin 'dzin pa'o// drag rlung de la zhag ci rigs sbyangs pas/ rtsa rgod rlung rgod thul nas drod ci rigs pa 'byung*/ de nas brtan par bya ba'i phyir/ rlung sbyor ba bzhi ldan sbyang ba ni/ rngub dang*/ dgang dang*/ gzhil dang*/ btang ba bzhi las/ dang po rngub pa ni/ rlung chung ba gcig rngub nas gnon/ de rjes dgang ba ni/ rlung drag po rngub nas thub thang gnon/ de nas gzhil ba ni/ mi thub pa 'dra ba dang*/ rlung cung zad se gol gtogs tsam gcig phyir btang nas de lhag thub thang du gnon/ btang ba ni/ de nas mi thub pa dang sangs rtser lhag ma ma lus par btang ngo*// gcig nor na bzhi char nor bas dran pa tu re bya/ goms nas dmigs pa la rtse gcig tu bya'o/ de nas 'jam rlung khug pa gsum ldan ni/ rngub pa sgra mi grags tsam du yun ring du rngub/ de rjes thub thang gnon/ mi thub pa dang ltag pa dgye tsam byas la sgra mi grags par sangs tshor btang*/ phyi ru gnas tshad gcig 'jog /'di la nyin (511)mtshan du sbyang*/ mi sngon du yang mi tshor bar skyang*/ rlung sbyor de gsum la ci rigs par sbyang ngo*// gnyis pa 'og zag med bde chen du sbar nas 'og sgo'i bcu gcig ston/

ces pa ni/ steng rlung brdzangs drags nas rlung sems bshang gci'i lam du shor na/ 'khor ba rgyas/ mya ngan las 'das pa rgyun chad/ rlung sems dhū tir tshud na/ mya ngan las 'das pa rgyas/ 'khor ba rgyun chad/ 'khor 'das gnyis kyi 'khrugs pa lte 'og sor bzhir byed pas/ steng rlung mnan pa'i rjes la srin po bskum/ shed sgrim/ thur sel gyen du 'then la lus cung zad bsgul rlung sbyor bum pa can bya'o// bar 'khor 'das rgyun gcod du sbar nas rtsa rlung gi chings gcig ston/ ces pa ni/ gsum ste/ lus 'khrul 'khor gyi gnad kyis bya ba las 'grul rgyun gcod/ ngag rlung sbyor gyi gnad kyis long gtam gyi 'grul rgyun gcod/ gsang ba yid dmigs pa rtse gcig gi gnad kyis rnam rtog 'grul rgyun gcod pa'o// lnga pa dmigs pa yul gyi gnad ni/ rang gi lus phyi rje btsun ma'i sku/ nang stong ra phrum phus btab pa lta bu'i nang du rtsa gsum gyi 'dus pa dbu ma'i mar snar a thung zangs ma'i mo khab tsam/ yang na thig le dmar po cog sgong tsam/ de las me sor bzhi 'bar bar bsgom/ me de mtshan nyid bzhi ldan kha dog dmar ba/ reg bya tsha ba/ rtse mo rno ba/ 'jam zhing mnyen pa'o// de rjes sor brgyad/ de rjes snying ga /de nas 'bar 'dzag ni/ me rta rnga tsam dhū ti'i nang nas yar song*/ tshangs bug gi ham̐ la reg /de las thig le nyungs 'bru tsam tshad nas chos 'byung gi nang du babs pas bde phril bar bskyar cing bsgom/ chos 'byung thig les gang bar bsam mo// de nas sum mdor gtum mo maṇ+ḍali me'i 'khor lo shin tu dmar zhing tsha ba/ mgar gyi lcags sgong la zhun btang ba lta bu bsgom/ des bde drod gnyis ka (512)cher skye'o/ ha cang drod che bar 'dod na/ 'khor lo de las me sbar/ rtsa'i drwa mig rnams me lce nyug nyug byung bas/ snying ga man chad me ru 'bar ba la sems gtad de/ me de yang mtshan nyid bzhi ldan te/

rnam pa me/ ngo bo rnal 'byor ma/ rang bzhin ye shes/ nyams myong bde drod do// gsum pa rjes kyi gnad la bzhi ste/ sbyong ba thabs kyi gnad dang*/ bang chen rtags kyi gnad dang*/ rang grol phyag rgya chen po'i gnad dang*/ spyod lam shugs 'byung gi gnad do// dang po la phyi sbyong ba dang nang sbyong ba gnyis las/ phyi sbyong ba ni/ gtum mo bsgoms pas/ drod khol bur skyes na brtan/ dus gcig la skyes na mi brtan/ byin rlabs kyi drod skabs su ma bsgoms na'ang mi 'chor ba'o// gos gcig bsgyur gnyis bsgyur bya/ de rjes ther ma'ang ras la sbyang*/ drod chen grang bar bsgom/ rdul byung na bsku mnye byas rjes sran phyes dril phyis bya/ mthar gang la yang ras gos kyis chag pa 'byung*/ de tsam na gos kyi 'dun pa dang bral/ 'byung ba khyad du gsod pa'i grub thob ces bya ba zas su yang rlung zos pas chog pa 'byung*/ nang sbyang ba ni/ lus 'khrul 'khor phyi'i gtum mo li ri ltar grims par sbyang*/ ngag rlung gi sbyor ba nang gi gtum mo gzhu rgyud ltar grim par sbyang*/ sems me mtshan nyid bzhi ldan gsang ba'i gtum mo mda' 'phangs kyi 'ben ltar grims par sbyang*/ bde ba rgyas pa'i dus su spong sems brtan pa dang*/ nyams su len pa'i tshe thig le srung ba zhal las shes/ 'jam rlung rdo rje'i bzlas pa yig 'bru gsum la sbyang pa dang*/ 'byung ba lnga'i rlung sangs rgyas lnga la kha dog so sor sbyong ba'ang zhal las shes so// gnyis pa bang chen rtags kyi gnad ni/ gtum mo bsgoms pas rtags bcu/ rdzu 'phrul bzhi/ 'du ba bzhi 'byung*/ rtags bcu ni thun mong lnga (513)dang khyad par gyi lnga'o// dang po ni/ rlung lnga zin pa'i rtags te dngos sam rmi lam dus rlung zin pas du ba dang*/ chu rlung zin pas smig rgyu dang*/ me rlung zin pas me khyer dang*/ rlung gi rlung gis mar me dang*/ nam mkha'i rlung gis sprin med pa'i nam mkha' lta bu 'byung ngo*// khyad par rlung lnga brtan pa'i rtags ni/

lte bar sa rlung brtan pas 'dug tshugs shing sa gzhi gser du mthong ngo*// zla zer lta bu dang thang chen po mthong*/ snying gar chu rlung brtan pas lus rdul/ snang ba chur mthong*/ nyi zer lta bu dang 'od dmar po mthong*/ mgrin par me rlung brtan pas drod che/ gos dang bral/ me chen po dang glog gi zer lta bu mthong*/ gsang gnas su rlung gi rlung brtan pas stobs che/ 'gro mgyogs rlung dang 'ja' tshon mthong*/ spyi bor nam mkha'i rlung brtan pas lus bde/ mdangs dang ldan/ nyi zla bsres pa lta bu mthong*/ rlung sems dbu mar tshud pas rlung lnga'i kha dog 'ja' tshon 'od kyi skud pa lta bu sna sgor mthong*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhing dang*/ rigs drug gi gnas mthong ba 'byung ste rlom sems med par byung rgyal du bskyang*/ rdzu 'phrul bzhi la/ me rlung dbang du 'dus pas nyi ma bstod la gnon/ seng ge thur du tshud pas chu bo gyen la bzlog /rlung sems dbang du 'dus pa lta stangs kyis pha rol rengs/ rlung gi rlung dbang du 'dus pas bar snang du skyil krung 'cha' nus so// 'du ba bzhi la/ rtsas nor 'du/ rlung gi mi 'du/ thig le mi ma yin/ cha mnyam gyi rlung ltas brtags pas dge mi dge shes/ rdzas dang zas 'du'o// gsum pa rang grol phyag rgya chen po'i gnad la gsum ste/ rtsa thams cad 'dres pas gsal ba rgyun gyis rtag pa ni/ da ltar gyi rtsa 'di rnams rnam smin gyi rtsa/ de'i nang na ye shes kyi rtsa kha dog dbyibs su ma grub pa bsgoms nas ngo 'phrod nus pa cig yod/ gtum mo bsgoms (514)pas rnam smin gyi rtsa dang ye shes kyi rtsa 'dres pas rnam pa gsal ba'i nyams rgyun du 'byung ba'o// de bzhin du rlung thams cad 'dres pas mi rtog pa rgyun gyis rtag pa/ thig le thams cad 'dres pas bde ba rgyun gyis rtag pa rnams kyang shes par bya'o// gnas pa rtsal rten nas gsal ba ngos 'dzin pa/

g.yo ba rlung la brten nas mi rtog pa ngos 'dzin pa/ byang sems thig le la brten nas bde ba ngos 'dzin pa// rtsa gsal stong*/ bde gsal mi rtog pa gsum zung du chud pa rgyud la skyes pa de kho na nyid kyi gtum mo zhes bya/ phyag rgya chen po zhes bya'o// bzhi pa spyod pa shugs 'byung gi gnas la gnyis/ rlung gi sbyor ba dang*// spyod lam gyi bya ba'o// dang po ni/ grang na drod btsan thabs su dbabs pa ni/ lus kyi rgan po bzhi btsugs la gcud par bya/ mgo ri rab kyi bar du bcug la steng 'og rlung kha sbyor ba'o// 'gro na srog rtsol gnad du bsnun ba ni/ gling bzhi bsdus la srin po gcod/ dran pa'i rgyun de dang ma bral ba gnad che'o// spyod lam ni/ rta mi zhon/ dung mi 'bud/ me dang nyi ma spang*/ thig le bsrung*/ tshwa ches pa dang*/ sga dang*/ sgog sngon dang*/ zwa dang*/ nya sha dang*/ sha rul dang*/ chang skyur dang*/ phye rul dang*/ gro phye dang*/ sran phye dang*/ chul 'khyag mi 'thung*/ nyin gnyid mi log /gzhan yang lus lha sku sgyu ma lta bu dang*/ ngag rlung rdo rje'i bzlas pa grag stong*/ sems stong nyid snying rje'i ting nge 'dzin dang mi 'bral bar bya'o// gtum mo bde drod rang 'bar gyi gdams ngag go /gnyis pa sgyu lus chos brgyad rang grol la bzhi ste/ gser 'gyur gyi rtsis dman pa mchog tu bsgyur ba dang*/ nyi zla'i 'od kyis ye shes ngo sprad pa dang*/ bstod smad kyis chos brgyad kyi rgya mdud grol ba dang*/ rjes grol zhing sgyu ma lam du khyer ba'o// dang po ni/ dper na gser 'gyur gyi rtsi gser (515)srang gcig gis lcags srang stong gser du bsgyur nus pa bzhin/ sgyu lus bsgoms pas 'jig rten gyi snang ba bden cing rtag par 'dod pa thams cad mi bden zhing brdzun pa sbun gog tu bshig par byed pa yin te/ de la gsum/ yi dam gser 'gyur gyi rtsi dang*/

bla ma gser 'gyur gyi rtsi dang*/ snang ba gser 'gyur gyi rtsi'o// dang po ni/ rang rje btsun mar bsgom/ sgyu ma rmi lam yin snyam du sems tur tur/ ngag tu thol thol brjod/ mig seb dang gnyid zam zi tshun chod sbyangs la bag chags 'dris nges rtag nges su bya/ bla ma gser 'gyur gyi rtsi ni/ spyi bor bla ma dang bka' brgyud gsum/ rmi lam yin sgyu ma yin snyam du sngar bzhin sbyang*/ snang ba gser 'gyur gyi rtsi ni/ mig gis gzugs mthong tshad la gzugs su snang dus nas rang gi ngo bos stong*/ gzugs snang stong sgyu ma lta bu yin snyam du bsgom/ rna bas sgra thos tshad grags dus nas ngo bos stong pa grags stong sgyu ma lta bu yin/ sems la rnam rtog 'phros tshad rnam rtog tu gsal dus na ngo bos stong pas sems gsal stong sgyu ma lta bur bsgom zhing sbyang*/ gnyis pa nyi zla'i 'od kyis ye shes ngo sprad pa la gsum/ 'pho 'gyur gyi dus la sbyang ba dang*/ nyi zla'i zer la ngo sprad pa dang*/ sgyu ma'i dpe bcu gnyis kyis mtshon te snang ba bden med du gtan la dbab pa'o// dang po ni/ skad cig gis rang rje btsun mar bsgoms la yul lnga gsal gdab/ mdun du rje btsun ma'i thang sku bkram la de la sems gtad/ sgyu ma yin rmi lam yin snyam du yid la bsgom zhing ngag tu'ang brjod/ de nas thang ga bsdus la yi dam bsgom/ phar bltas pas lha tshogs rnams snang tsam nas stong*/ stong tsam nas snang*/ snang stong sgyu ma rmi lam lta bur bsgom/ de la shes pa mi gnas na mdun gyi lha rang la bstim/ rang rje (516)btsun ma dbyer med du bzhag /de la skyon bla ma'i rnal 'byor gsal gdab/ bskyar cing bsgoms la/ ye shes mkha' 'gro sgyu ma'i sku/ sgyu ma stong pa'i ngo bo nyid/ stong nyid brjod du med par sprod/ sgyu lus 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ ces gsol ba gdab/ rgyas par byed na/

rdo rje 'chang chen sgyu ma'i sku/ ces brgyud pa la gsol ba gdab/ de thams cad sgyu ma yin pas stong pa/ stong pa yin pas skye med/ skye med yin pas spros bral/ spros bral yin pas chos sku yin snyam du thag rbad kyis bcad la/ de ga'i ngang la ying sing nge ye re tshugs tshad du bzhag /gnyis pa nyi zla'i zer la ngo sprod pa ni// khang ba bla gab med pa'am/ yang na phyogs bzhir mun skar bzhi phug la phyag dar bya/ snga dro kha shar/ nyin phyed lho/ dgong mo nub tu blta/ shar gyi mun skar gyi/ thad du ral gri/ lhor me long*/ nub tu rgya bskyegs kyi khu ba/ byang du glegs bam bzhag /des cir snang bden med du 'char/ snang ba bun long 'gro ba'i rten 'brel lo// yi dam ma rdo rje sems dpa'i thang ga gsar ba cig rgyab tu bkram/ sngar bzhin bla ma yi dam bsgoms la gsol ba gdab/ chu dang me long gi nang du lha sku shar ba la rig pa gtad/ skabs su lha sku la sogs pa chu dang me long nang du shar ba la brtag pa bzhi bya/ de yod nas 'char na bzung bas zin rgyu la mi zin/ med nas 'char na de'i nang du 'ong ba med par byung*/ de'ang thang sku bris pa las thon nas der 'ongs pa'ang min/ lha sku glo bur du gzhan nas byung nas der thim pa'ang min/ de med bzhin rten 'brel 'tshogs pa'i rdzun snang tsam du shar bas/ de bzhin du 'khor 'das kyi chos dang da ltar gyi snang ba thams cad shes par bya/ thun bshol khar lha rang la bstim/ rang dang snang ba thams cad sgyu ma/ sgyu ma yin pas stong pa la sogs pa thams cad 'gre/ (517)gsum pa sgyu ma'i dpe bcu gnyis kyi mtshon te snang ba bden med du gtan la 'bebs pa ni/ rgyu rkyen las grub pas sgyu ma/ g.yo ba dang bcas pas smig rgyu/ gnas dang longs spyod med bzhin du snang bas dri za'i grong khyer/ snang la rang bzhin med pas 'ja' tshon/ gsal la rdzogs pas me long gi gzugs/

kun la khyab pas chu zla/ rang yin pa gzhan du snang ba brag cha/ sems dang bcas pas rmi lam/ mi rtag cing myur bas glog /med bzhin snang bas mig yor/ gcig kyang du mar 'byung bas sprin/ gzugs sna tshogs pas sprul pa/ de rnams kyi don la res phar blta/ res tshur blta/ de rang la bltims la snga ma ltar bsgom par bya'o// gsum pa bstod smad kyi chos brgyad kyi rgya mdud dgrol ba ni/ lha sku bsdus la me long la rang gi gzugs 'char bar byas la/ rang gi ming nas bton la/ khyod pas pho grung ba/ btsun pa/ gtong phod che ba med la sogs pa byas kyang de la dga' ba med/ sdom nyams/ dam nyams la sogs pa byas kyang mi dga' ba med/ sgyu ma lta bu la dga' mi dga' yong ba med pa dngos su ro snyom ste/ gzhan gyis bstod ra gtong gin 'dug na'ang de la dga' mi dga' mi bya de la brtag pa gnyis bya ste/ yon tan yod nas bstod na/ brjod pas lhag tu mi 'gro bas dga' bar mi rigs/ med pa la bstod na tshig stod phye 'thor la dga' bar mi rigs/ gzhan gyis smad ra btang na mi dga' ba mi bya/ de la brtag pa gnyis bya/ skyon de yod nas smad na/ yod pa brjod pa la mi dga' ba mi rigs/ med na tshig stong la mi dga' bar mi rigs so// de bzhin du bde zhing skyid par snang na de la dga' bar mi bya/ de la brtag pa gsum bya/ lus bem po ro dang 'dra ste de la bde skyid ma grub/ ngag brag ca dang 'dra ste bde skyid ma grub/ sems nam mkha' dang 'dra ste bde skyid ma grub/ (518)ma grub pa la snang ba de sgyu ma/ sgyu ma la dga' bar mi bya'o// sdug pa'i snang ba byung na mi dga' ba mi bya/ de la brtag pa gsum bya/ lus bem por/ ngag brag ca/ sems nam mkha' 'dra bas sdug pa ma grub/ ma grub bzhin du sdug par snang ba sgyu ma'o// de bzhin du rnyed pa chen dga' bar mi rigs/ de la brtag pa gsum bya/ nor zang zing bden par ma grub bzhin snang ba mig 'phrul gyi nor dang 'dra bar dga' bar mi rigs/

phugs su 'tshengs mi nus la/ 'phral spyod dbang med pa rmi lam gyi nor bu'i gter rnyed pa dang 'dra bas dga' bar mi rigs/ de la zhen nas phung khrol thams cad 'byung*/ nong phyir srog kyang 'chor ba sbrang ma'i chi dang 'dra bar dga' bar mi rigs/ rnyed pa chung ba la mi dga' ba mi bya/ de la brtag pa gsum bya ba sngar bzhin no// de bzhin du grags ma grags gnyis po gong gi bstod smad la dga' mi dga' mi rigs pa dang 'dra/ de ltar chos brgyad sgyu mar 'byongs/ chags sdang mi skye na bar dor mngal sgo khegs/ rgya mdud rang sar grol/ bzhi pa rjes grol zhing sgyu ma lam du khyer ba ni/ snang ba thams cad rigs lnga'i bdag nyid sgyu ma lta bur bltas te/ phung po lnga yab lnga/ 'byung ba lnga yum lnga/ phyogs yul/ dbang po yan lag /'dod yon der 'dzin gyi rtog pa thams cad sku dang ye shes sgyu mar snang stong du blta bar bya/ sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin des phyag rgya thams cad la 'jug /dkyil 'khor thams cad bya/ 'dod yon thams cad spyad/ rgyan thams cad 'gags/ spyod pa thams cad bya/ gar dang rol mo smra rgod la sogs pa thams cad bya/ grub mtha' thams cad bsgyur/ lam thams cad bgrod do// ci'i phyir na thams cad sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul yin par shes pa'i phyir/ nyes ltung gis mi gos so// de ltar shes pas mchod rten dang*/ dge slong la sogs pa (519)la phyag mi bya ste/ de dag bem po'i gzugs brnyan ni sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul yin pa'i phyir ro// kha ton dang*/ sngags bzla ba dang*/ srung 'khor bsgoms pa la sogs pa mi bya'o// yang na phyag dang sngags bgrang ba la sogs pa thams cad sgyu ma'i ngang nas bya/ de ltar 'khor 'das kyis chos thams cad bden med du shes nas sgyu ma lta bur 'char na/ sgyu lus kyi nyams shar ba'o// snang ba sems can thams cad dngos po dang mtshan mas ma gos par chos skur shar ba la zhen pa med na/

sgyu lus kyi rtogs pa shar ba'o// rig gsum mgon po bsgoms pas gzhan gyi blo ngan sel/ me yi phyag rgyas 'jig rten sreg par byed pa de dus su 'byung*/ mnyam rjes med na tshe 'di la lus 'ja' lus dang*/ sems chos sku thob nas mchog thob pa'o// sgyu lus chos brgyad rang grol gyi gdams ngag rdzogs so// gsum pa rmi lam 'khrul pa rang sangs la bzhi ste/ dran pa'i lcags kyus bzung ba dang*/ brjed skul gyis sbyang ba dang*/ phrin las kyi mdzad pa sgyu mar byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ de kho na nyid bsgom pa'o// dang po la gsum/ yi dam dran pa'i lcags kyus gzung ba dang*/ bla ma dran pa'i lcags kyus gzung ba dang*/ snang ba dran pa'i lcags kyus bzung ba rnams sgyu lus gyi gser 'gyur rtsi dang 'dra'o// gnyis pa brjed skul gyis sbyang ba ni/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom/ rmi lam zin par gsol ba gdab/ nyin mo rmi lam ya mtshan can mang po yid kyis dmigs la/ de rnams rmi lam yin par 'dug /da ngas rmi lam gzung dgos snyam du dran 'dun brgya rtsa re tsam bya/ rmi lam sbyang pa mgrin par sbyang*/ 'dzin pa smin mtshams su 'dzin pas/ nyal khar bla ma snang ba mtha' yas kyi ngo bo mgrin par bsgom/ phyi nang gsang (520)gsum gyi mchod pa phul/ gsol ba gdab/ mgo nub bde ba can du bstan pas gnas nges ngar byad/ gzhogs g.yas 'og tu phab/ seng ge'i nyal stabs byas pas rlung sems gnad du tshud nas lus des par byed/ 'dzin pa smin mtshams kyi bar thig le dkar po mu tig lta bu gcig la dran pa tu re bar gtad/ gnyid log pas sems nges par byed/ rmi lam ma zin na don med yin snyam pa bya/ gnyid 'thum pa re bya/ skabs su rlung rtsol bag re bsgom/ gnyid sad res zhing thig le la rig pa gtad/ rmi lam rmi lam du shes na zin pa'o// gsum pa phrin las kyi mdzad pa sgyu mar byin gyis brlab pa la bzhi/

sprul pa dang*/ bsgyur ba dang*/ spel ba dang*/ lus kyi skar mda' gar 'dod du 'phang ba'o// dang po ni/ rmi lam du dgra yis ded pa'am/ chu khyer ba'am/ g.yang la lhung la khad pa'am/ gzugs mi sdug pa la sogs pa byung na/ de la 'jig skrag gi snang ba 'char/ 'di rmi lam yin snyam du shes par byas la/ 'byung po la sogs pa rmi na de dar de'i gnyen por sprul nas 'dul ba zhal las shes/ gnyis pa bsgyur ba ni/ rmi lam zin pa dang*/ gcig mang por bsgyur/ mang po gcig tu bsgyur/ gzugs chen po chung ngur bsgyur/ chung ngu chen por bsgyur/ dud 'gro mir/ mi lha ru// khang khyim rin po che'i gzhal yas khang du bsgyur/ rdzas dang mtshon cha rdo rje dril bu dang*/ po tir bsgyur/ chu dang*/ me dang*/ g.yangs sa thams cad la rmi lam yin pas 'jigs rgyu med snyam du mi phod pa la thog brdzis byas la mchong*/ sa chu ru bsgyur/ chu me ru bsgyur/ steng 'og brje// mdor na rmi lam gyi snang ba thams cad stobs bskyed la bsgyur bar bya'o// gsum pa spel ba ni/ dngos po gang snang gcig gnyis su spel/ gnyis bzhi/ bzhi brgyad/ brgyad (521)brgya'i bar nas dpag tu med par spel lo// sgyu ma mthar ma skyol na nyin nub brtag pa gnad che ste/ nyin mo rmi lam yin snyam nas g.yang la mchong na srog dang bral lo// bzhi pa lus kyi skar mda' gang 'dod du 'phang ba ni/ nyin par dran 'dun drag pos o rgyan/ 'og min/ mngon dga'/ rdo rje gdan la sogs pa bltar 'gro bsam pa bya/ rang gi mdun nam/ spyi bor yi dam dang bla ma dbyer med snang la rang bzhin med pa gcig bsgom/ de'i mgrin par pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa gcig bsam/ de'i lte bar oṃ/ 'dab ma bzhi la lām̐ mām̐ bām̐ tām̐ bsam/ yang na a nu ta ra hūm̐ bsam/ de nas rang rje btsun mar bsam/ rang dang mdun bskyed gnyis ka la mchod pa 'bul/ rang nyid mdun gyi lha'i mgrin par thim pa la/

yig 'bru lnga la re mos su rig pa hu re gtad/ gnyid du hrib rtsar 'gro dus rang las sems thon nas mdun bskyed kyi lhar sems zhugs pas cung zhig 'gul ba la rag pa gtad/ lus ma lan 'dug par bsam/ sprul pa'i yid lus des o rgyan la sogs par 'gro snyam pa'i dran 'dun gyi ngang nas gnyid log go /de nas rmi lam nang du rmi lam du 'dug snyam pa dang*/ skad cig la bya rgod la sogs pa'i sprul pa'i lus zung 'jug gi 'dab shog dang ldan pas 'phur nas phyin pas gang 'dod du phyin pa'i nyams 'byung ngo*// de la goms pas chu zla lta bu'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhal dngos su mthong nas chos nyan pa la sogs pa byed de/ mtshan mo'i rmi lam dang*/ nyin bar gyi sgyu lus la khyad med do// mi ma yin pa'i bar chad byung na rang gis kyang rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs bstan la gdul bar bya'o// gzhan yang rmi lam gyi gegs bsal ba ni/ rmi lam mi zin pa'i rgyu bzhi/ rkyen bzhi'o// rgyu bzhi ni/ dam tshig nyams pa/ mos gus zhan pa/ mngon zhen che ba/ (522)grib kyis phog pa'o// sel thabs ni/ dang po la dbang bskur/ bshags pa bya/ dam tshig sdom pa gso'o// gnyis pa la mos gus drag po bya/ gsol ba gdab/ maṇ+ḍal dbul/ bla ma ci mnyes la 'bad/ gsum pa la yo byad spong dag bya/ gang la'ang chags zhen spang*/ mi rtag pa bsgom/ bzhi pa la gcig pur bsdad/ sdig can dang*/ sdom med dang mi 'grogs/ ro gos dang mi gtsang ba la 'dzem/ yi ge brgya pa bzla'o// rkyen bzhi ni/ sad 'byams/ 'khrul 'byams/ brjed 'byams/ rgyun 'byams so// sad 'byams ni/ 'dzin 'phro la gnyid du ma song snyam pa dang*/ gnyid sad pa yin snyam nas 'dzin 'phro gcod pa dang*/ rmi lam ma zin par long med du sad pa'o// de la 'dzin 'phro mi gcod par yang nas yang du gzung*/ gnyid long med par sad na/ gang gis lan brtags te sgra'i klag cor gyis sad na mi med sar nyal/

zin pa la dga' ches pas sad na sems klod/ las kyang bas sad na gtum mo bsgom pa'am/ gos mthug tu gtong*/ gnyis pa 'khrul 'byams ni/ rmi lam la rmi lam du ma shes par 'khrul pa 'ba' zhig pa'o// de la mos gus bskyed la gsol ba gdab/ snang ba thams cad rmi lam yin sgyu ma yin snyam pa'i dran 'dun drag po yang yang bya/ gsum pa brjed 'byams ni 'dzin pa la sogs pa ma byung bar brjed pa'o// de la 'dzin sbyang dang gsal po rmi ba'i dran 'dun drag po bya/ bzhi pa bsdug 'byams ni/ rmi lam ma byung ba'am/ byung yang ngos ma zin pa'o// bzhi pa rmi lam gyi de kho na nyid bsgom pa ni/ rmi lam gyi snang ba thams cad sems kyi rnam 'phrul/ bzang ngan thams cad sgyu ma'i rtsal kha/ gzugs thams cad snang stong*/ sgra grags stong*/ sems (523)gdod ma nas skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba/ rmi lam dang nyin bar gyi snang bar khyad med par bden med rang shar rang grol yin par sgyu ma lta bu yin pas stong pa la sogs pa'i ngang du gzhag par bya'o// rmi lam 'khrul pa rang sangs gyi gdams ngag go /bzhi pa 'od gsal ma rig mun bral la lnga ste/ lus gnad la brten nas sems mal du gzhug pa dang*/ lus gnad la brten nas sgom pa ngos gzung ba dang*/ ye shes pa'i spyan pas ma rig pa'i glang po gzung ba dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi ye shes ngo sprad pa dang*/ rjes spyod 'od gsal gyi bogs 'don pa'o// dang po ni/ gnas dben par chu dron mos lus bkru/ de nas dri chus/ de nas chang gis/ de nas zhun chen nam/ med na mar gyis byug /de nas dri bzang gis byug /lus kyi bya ba spangs te dal bar bsdad/ thabs shes rab kyi zas bsten/ zhag gsum gnyid bsrung bar bya'o// gnyis pa yul gnad la brten nas sgom pa ngos gzung ba la bzhi ste/ dus gnod/ yul gnad/ lus gnad/ dmigs pa'i gnad do// dus gnad ni/ nam smad nas nyi ma dros kyi bar dang*/

gnyid du song nas rmi lam ma byung gi bar rlung dbu mar 'jug pa'i dus so// yul gnad ni/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po gling bzhi las mi 'da' ba bzhin/ rang gi rig pa 'di 'khor lo bzhi las mi 'da' ste/ tha mal gyi dus na lte bar gnas/ gnyid dus na snying ga /rmi lam gyi dus na mgrin pa/ snyoms 'jug dus na spyi bo na gnas so// des na yul snying ga chos kyi 'khor lor gnad du bsnan pa'o// lus gnad ni/ g.yas 'og tu phab/ g.yon bstod la seng ge'i nyal stabs sam/ tsog gnyid bya'o// shar mngon dga'i phyogs su mgo (524)bstan no// dmigs pa'i gnad ni/ snying gi rtse mo gyen la bstan pa'i nang du pad+ma sngon po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba la hūm̐ sngon po/ phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma la mdun du a dkar po/ g.yas su nu ser po/ rgyab tu ta dmar po/ g.yon du ra ljang gu rnams gsal bar dmigs par bya'o// gsum pa ye shes kyi spyan pas ma rig pa'i glang po gzung ba ni/ bla ma ye shes spyan pa/ slob ma ma rig pa'i glang po'o// 'di la gnyis/ ba thag gser phur la glang po btags pa dang*/ rin chen tho bas ma rig pa'i gnyid sad pa'o// dang po ni/ ras bal gyi skud pa 'dom gang pa gcig slob ma'i skra la btags/ de bla ma'i srin lag la btags so// rin chen thob ni/ shing phra mo 'dom gang pa gcig gi rtse mo la ras kyi pho lto bskon pa gcig byas/ de nas sngon du bla ma la tshogs 'khor dbul/ bka' brgyud la gsol ba drag tu gdab/ bdag gi slob ma la 'od gsal zin par byin gyis rlobs bya/ zhun chen gyi mar me mtshan thub gtong*/ sha chen gyis brgyan pa'i gtor ma gta' ru gzung*/ mkha' 'gro zas kyi phud kyis mchod/ slob mas mtshams gcad/ thig le bsrung*/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor byas la gsol ba gdab bo// de yang gnyid du 'gro ba dang 'chi ba tshul mthun pa yin pas/ 'byung ba bzhi thim pa'i 'gros ni/

dang po gnyid du 'gro dus sa chu la thim pas lus lci yor ba dang*/ shes pa nag thib ba dang*/ kha chu nar re 'ong*/ chu me la thim pas dpral ba tsha 'ub mig tshum cher te 'gro/ me rlung la thim pas sna su su sdur ba ngar ngar 'ong*/ rlung rnam shes la thim pas nyin mo'i rnam rtog 'gag /mtshan mo'i rmi lam ma byung ba'i bar der gnyid kyi 'od gsal stong pa mtha' dbus (525)med pa nam mkha' ltar ngos bzung med pa sa le seng nge ba gcig yong ba de ngos 'dzin pa'o// de nas bla mas/ ngas de ltar skud pa 'then/ dbyug gus brgyud bya yi/ 'od gsal zin na zin 'phro gcig la bsgom/ ma zin na bskyor la sgoms la/ ral lan ma ster bya'o// de yang zin na phyi rtags dbang po'i mdangs ya le yong*/ sdur pa mi 'ong*/ ma zin na ba thag gser phur 'then tsam bya/ rin chen tho ba thug thug bya'o// des gnyid mi sang*/ gdams pa gsal 'debs pa'o// bzhi pa ting nge 'dzin gyi ye shes ngo sprad pa ni/ gcig car ba gang zin du ngo sprad pa dang*/ rim gyis cho ga la brten nas nyams dang sbyar nas ngo sprad pa'o// dang po ni/ gcig car ba la nges med du 'od gsal zin pa 'byung bas de la yid ches bskyed par bya'o// rim gyis ba ngo sprad pa ni/ dang po gnyid log khar tha mal gyi dus su a la shes pa gtad pas yul rags pa'i rtog pa thim pas/ snang ba stong pa ngos gzung*/ gnyid hrib pa dang nu la gtad pas yul phra ba'i rtog pa thams cad thim/ mched pa dang shin tu stong pa/ de bas kyang cher hrib pa dang ta la gtad pas ches phra ba'i rtog pa thim pas/ thob pa dang stong pa chen po/ shin tu hrib pa'i dus su ra la gtad pas rtog pa thams cad thim pas nye bar thob pa dang thams cad stong pa'o// hrib kyis song ba'i dus su hūm̐ la gtad pas rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa thams cad thim pas 'od gsal chen po ngos gzung bar bya'o// yang na gnyid hrib pa'i dus du 'dod chags kyi rtog pa bzhi bcu 'gag

/cher hrib pa'i dus su zhe sdang gi rtog pa sum cu rtsa gsum 'gag /shin tu hrib pa'i dus su gti mug gi rtog pa bdun 'gag nas 'od gsal chos sku'i don 'char ro// (526)de nas gnyid sad pa dang*/ nyin mtshan gcig tu bsres nas rgyun chad med par bsgom par bya'o// 'od gsal gyi gegs sel zhal las shes/ lnga pa rjes spyod 'od gsal gyi bogs 'don pa ni/ spros bcas spros med gnyis pas spros bcas ni/ mdun gyi bar snang du hūm̐ sngon po bai ḍūr+ya'i mdog can shin tu gsal ba rtog pas bar ma chod par bsgom/ de nas skye na hūm̐ rigs lnga'i rang bzhin tu zhabs kyu ha la thim/ ha mgo bo la/ mgo bo zla tshes la/ zla tshes thig le la/ thig le nā da la/ de 'od gsal du yal bas stong nyid mi rtog pa'i ngang du gzhag /de la skyon lha sku stong ra'i thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po bsgom/ de 'od du zhu/ stong ra'ang sngo nar gang*/ de je che la nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i ngang du gzhag go /spros med ni/ da ltar gyi snang ba sna tshogs 'di me long gi gzugs brnyan nam chu nang gi zla ba ltar snang tsam du zang kyi ngo bo la grub pa med par shes par byas la/ rjes thob la sngar gyi sgyu lus su langs la bya ba ci byed thams cad la 'jug par bya'o// de ltar brtson 'grus dang ldan pas dus la mi ltos par tshe 'di nyid dang 'chi khar sa bcu'i rtogs pa skye bar 'gyur ro// 'od gsal ma rig mun bral gyi gdams ngag go /lnga pa 'pho ba gser 'gyur gyi rtsi'i gdams ngag ni/ sngar gyi de lta bus lam bgrod pa yin pa la/ gal lte dus kyi gtugs na 'pho ba bya ste/ de la gnyis/ thun mong dang*/ khyad par ro// thun mong ni/ ser sna sbyin par 'pho/ 'dod chags tshul khrims la/ zhe sdang bzod par/ le lo brtson 'grus su/ rnam g.yeng bsam gtan du/ gti mug shes rab tu/ rang 'dod gzhan don du/ rnam rtog bskyed rim du 'pho ba'o// khyad par gyi 'pho ba la gnyis/

yul gang du 'pho ba dang*/ thabs gang gis 'pho ba'o// yul gang du 'pho ba la (527)gsum/ spros med chos skur 'pho ba dang*/ spros bcas gzugs skur 'pho ba dang*// yid 'ong mkha' 'gro'i grong du 'pho ba'o// 'pho thabs la gsum/ rab 'od gsal du 'pho ba dang*/ 'bring sgyu lus su 'pho ba dang*/ tha ma bskyed rim gyis 'pho ba'o// dang po la gnyis/ rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal dang*/ bsam gtan gyi 'od gsal lo// rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal du 'pho ba ni// sems can thams cad la 'chi dus su phyi dbugs chad nas nang dbugs ma chad pa'i bar du 'od gsal 'char bas/ de ngos bzung la de'i steng du ma yengs par bzhag pas lam gyi 'od gsal dang gcig tu 'dres nas chos skur sangs rgyas pa'o// de la da lta gnyid kyi 'od gsal zin pa gcig dgos so// de la goms pa chung na bsam gtan gyi 'od gsal du 'pho ba ni// 'chi khar lus gnad gang bde byed// skye med 'od gsal ngos gzung la/ de la skad cig kyang ma yengs par bya/ dbugs ring thung gi dus su ha byas pas shes pa dang nam mkha' bsre la btang*/ chos skur sangs rgyas pa'o// gnyis pa sgyu lus su 'pho ba la gnyis te/ rang bzhin gyi sgyu lus dang*/ bsam bstan gyi sgyu lus so// dang po ni/ sngar sgyu lus la goms shing sbyangs pa de la/ ci ltar sbyangs pa'i dngos po thams cad sgyu mar shes pa'i ngang nas zhen pa dang chags pa spu tsam yang med par 'phos pas longs skur sangs rgya'o// de la goms pa chung na/ bsam gtan gyi sgyu lus su 'pho ba ni/ lus tha mal du zhen pa'i gnyen por lha sku snang la rang bzhin med par bsgom/ ngag tha mal du zhen pa'i gnyen por ā li kā li brjod/ sems tha mal du zhen pa'i gnyen por chos thams cad rang bzhin med par shes par bya/ gzugs snang stong*/ (528)sgra grags stong*/ rtog pa gsal stong*/ chos thams cad sgyu ma/ sgyu ma'i ngang nas 'dun pa drag po yang yang bya zhing rlung dang bstun nas 'phos pas longs sku sgyu ma lta bur sangs rgyas so// gsum pa bskyed rim gyis 'pho ba la gnyis te/

sbyangs te 'pho ba dang*/ btsan thabs su 'pho ba'o// dang po la gnyis te/ sbyang ba dang*/ 'pho ba'o// dang po sbyang ba la gnyis te/ dran pa'i spyan pas nyes pa'i skyon bsal ba dang*/ hūm̐ gi sang phrug gangs la 'phyo ba'o// dang po ni/ bdag ring por mi thogs par 'chi dus 'di ga ltar du 'chi/ des na sems can gyi don du 'pho ba sbyang snyam du bsam/ de ma byas na dus min lha bsad pa'i nyes pa 'byung ngo*// rang rje btsun mar bskyed/ rtsa dbu ma mda' smyug tsam bsgom/ spyi bo'i tshangs bug k+ṣa dmar nag gcig gis bkag par bsgom/ snying gar rlung sems 'dus pa'i ngo bo hūm̐ sngon po ba thag tsam btags par bsam/ gnyis pa hūm̐ gi seng phrug gangs la 'phyo ba ni// steng gi nam mkha' la bla ma yi dam tha mi dad pa thugs kar pad+ma kha bye ba'i tshul du bsgom/ 'pho ba 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsol ba gdab/ rlung ro bus nas rlung nang du drag tu ring bar rngub/ steng rlung chil gyis mnan pas snying ga'i hūm̐ de mar song lte 'og gi a dang 'dres par bsam/ thur ser gcud/ srin po bskum/ rgyu zhabs nyongs byas la/ ngag tu hig ka hig byas nas drangs pas hūm̐ a ba dhū ti'i nang na yar song bas spyi bo'i k+ṣa la thug /thod pa ser ka shig shig rus pa theb gang dang*/ sha khrag dang bcas pa rgyangs thon nas bla ma'i thugs kar song*/ yang rlung rngub hūm̐ mar byung*/ srog gi rgyun ba thag lta bu la zhon nas snying gar thug tser babs par bsam/ de bzhin du rlung rtsol nyer gcig gam/ lnga bcu rtsa lnga tsam re sbyang*/ thun (529)bshol khar bla ma rang la bstims la sang sprug bya/ rjes gnas lugs kyi don la ji srid gnas par gzhag go /tshad ma zin na ngos su 'pho bas tshong zin par bya'o// 'byongs pa'i tshad ni// spyi gtsug rtse ba dang*/ g.ya' ba dang*/ dra ba dang*/ 'phrig pa dang*/ skrangs pa dang*/ khrag chu ser thon pa dang*/

shes pa phyed phyed pa dang*/ dbugs stod du 'tshangs pa dang*/ snying na kheng pa 'byung ngo*// de ltar byung ba dang sbyong 'phro bcad/ 'chi dus su blo gtad thub pas yid ches par bya'o// gnyis pa 'pho ba ni/ 'chi ltas tshang ba dang*/ 'chi ltas brtag pa zhal las shes/ nam mkha' la bla ma yi dam gnyis med thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes bde ba chen po dang ldan pa'i thugs pad+ma 'dam ma brgyad pa kha bye ba'i tshul du bsams la/ snga ma ltar hūm̐ la rnam shes bsdus la/ spyi bo'i k+ṣa gsal btab la 'og rlung gcud la thugs kar 'phos pas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dang*/ bdag gi shes pa dbyer med du 'dres pa dang*/ phyir bskyed byas pas srog gi rgyun ba thag lta bu rbad kyis chad par bsams la/ rlung gcud pas lan gcig gis nges par 'pho ba'o// de dus bla ma'i grogs la sogs pas bde stong la gnas par gyis zhes bsgrag par bya'o// rlung las mi nus na/ seng ge'i nyal stabs byas la gzhan snga ma dang 'dra'o// gnyis pa btsan thabs su 'pho ba la gsum/ lus gnad la brten nas 'khor ba'i 'grul bcad pa dang*/ shel gyi 'ban btsug pa dang*/ ka hig gi mdas gang 'dod kyi gnas su 'phang ba'o// dang po ni/ sems bskyed/ gsol ba gdab/ sgo dgu gang rung nas rnam shes thon nas de dang der skye ba sangs rgyas kyis kyang mi khegs pas/ 'khrul 'khor seng ge rnam grol 'di shin tu zab bo/ srin (530)zhal dmyal ba'i sgo yin pas rting bas bkag /'og rlung bsdams/ bya kang dus 'gro'i sgo long mo gnyis kyi bar du btsir/ skyes dman la rtigs pas gdab/ 'brub khung yi dwags kyi sgo mthe'u chung gis dgag snom byed gnod sbyin gyi sgo srin lag gis dgag ma thub na g.yon nas gtang*/ lta byed mi'i sgo gung mos dgag /nyan byed lha'i sgo mthe bong gis dgag /gnyis pa shel gyi 'ben gzug ba ni/ bla ma yi dam gang gsal cig spyi bo ru 'dom gang tsam du bzhugs pa'i thugs pad+ma kha 'byed pa'i tshul du bsgom/

ka hig gi mdas gang 'dod du 'phang ba ni/ thag pa'am dbyug pa la rgyab bkal/ khong du ka hig brjod/ shes pa shel gyi 'ben la 'phang*/ sbyor ba gcig gis nges par 'pho ba'o// gnyis dang gsum gyis mi 'pho mi srid do// gnad bzhi zhal las shes/ ma bsgoms sangs rgyas 'pho ba gser 'gyur rtsi'i gdams ngag go /drug pa grong 'jug sbrul lpags 'dor byed ni// dper na sbrul de nam zla dbyar ngor pags pa rnying ba de dor nas gsar bu gcig 'byung ba ltar/ rang gi lam yongs su ma rdzogs shing rten dman par gyur na/ shes pa gzhan lus kyi rten grong du zhugs la don chen bsgrub par bya'o// 'di la gsum ste/ 'jug bya yul gyi gnad kyis chad ldan du sbyang ba dang*/ 'jug byed rten gyi gnad kyis gar 'dod du 'phang ba dang*/ mthun rkyen grog kyi gnad kyis rnam shes gsal gdab ba'o// dang po la gsum ste/ thod pa la sbyang ba dang*/ bom pa la sbyang ba dang*/ srog chags kyi ro la sbyang ba'o// dang po la gnyis te/ rten liṅga bca' ba dang*/ brten pa'i las sbyor bya ba'o// dang po ni/ thod pa mtshan ldan gyi nang du rtsi nag pos byug /dbus su rdo rgyus kyis hūm̐ mgo rang la bstan pa bri/ (531)dar dmar pos kha gcad/ gnas dben par maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi pa byi dor byas pa'i dkyil du stegs kyi khar thod pa rnal 'byor pa'i shar du bstan la gzhag go /gnyis pa brten pa'i las sbyor bya ba ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya/ bla ma yi dam spyan drangs la gsol ba gdab/ de nas rlung gzung*/ hūm̐ dang rnam shes tha dad med pa dhū ti'i nang nas mar song*/ gsang gnas su byung*/ 'og rlung drag tu 'then pas hūm̐ de dhū ti nas yar byung*/ sna bug g.yas na thod pa'i kha'i dar la thal gyis song nas/ thod nang hūm̐ la tim gyis thim pa la shes pa shi ma shi med par gtad la/ rlung tshur bzlog tu mi 'jug par yun ring du gzhag

/srog gi rgyun pa thag lta bu bsgom/ de ltar sbyangs pas dang po thod pa la drod tsha 'ur ngo 'ong*/ de nas dud pa lta bu sngo phyur phyur ba 'ong*/ tsag tsag pa'i skad 'ong*/ dar de yang 'gul 'gul bteg bteg nam mkha' la lding gis 'gro/ thod pa de'ang dum bur 'gro ba 'ong*/ bskyed rim brtan cing gtum mo 'byongs na 'dis nges par 'grub bo// gnyis pa bem po la sbyang ba ni/ bal 'dab bam/ ras kyi dum bu'am/ phying pa mtho skor la sogs pa la sngar ltar byas pas drod dang 'phar g.yo 'byung ngo*// gsum pa sems can gyi ro la sbyang ba ni/ lu gu la sogs pa sems can gang yang rung ba'i rol bya ste/ ro'i kha rang la bstan/ rang gi rnam shes hūm̐ dang dbyer med sna bug g.yas nas thon ro'i sna bug g.yon du zhugs nas de'i snying nang du hūm̐ la rig pa gtad/ bya'i ro yin na the gu btags la phur ba la brtod/ rtags ni mtshan khung du drod yong*/ de nas lus kun la yong*/ de nas 'gul ba dang 'dar ba yong*/ de'i dus su dran pa stor 'kho bas nyams myong can gyis tshod bya'o// gnyis pa 'jug byed rten (532)gyi gnad kyis gang 'dod du 'phang ba la gnyis/ shel gyi 'ben gzugs pa dang*/ hūm̐ gi mda' 'phang ba'o// dang po ni/ rgas pa dang*/ mdze pho dang*/ dbang po ma tshang ba la sogs pa'i ro ma yin pa dang*/ na so gzhon pa dang*/ rigs bzang ba dang*/ gcong nad med pa dang*/ rma med pa dang*/ ma rul ba/ ma sum pa/ glo bur du shi ba'i ro btsal la bur chu dang sug chus bkru/ dri bzang byug gos bskon/ rgyan btags/ maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du skyil krung bzhag skra yod na brtod/ med na brten par bya/ ro de kha shar du bstan no// gnyis pa hūm̐ gi mda' 'phang ba ni/ rang dkyil 'khor gyi shar du kha nub tu bltas te 'dug /sems bskyed/ rang rje btsun mar bsgom// bka' brgyud spyan drangs la gsol ba gdab/ ro de bla ma yi dam dbyer med du bskyed la/

snga ma ltar ro'i snying gar hūm̐ bsams la/ rang gi shes pa hūm̐ la bsdus la/ sna bug g.yas pa nas bton la/ ro'i sna bug g.yon pa nas song te snying ga'i hūm̐ la bstim mo// gsum pa mthun rkyen grogs kyi gnad kyis rnam shes gsal gdab pa la gsum ste/ sgras brjed bskul bya dang*/ zas kyis drod bskyed pa dang*/ mi ldog par bya ba'i phyir ro ring du 'phang ba'o// dang po ni/ grogs blo brtan pa gcig la grong 'jug gi rog bcol/ ro de 'gul ba dang*/ mig hrig pa dang*/ rngam pa ha zer ba dang*/ rna ba g.yas nas gsang mtshan nas 'bod/ khyod grong 'jug byas pa yin no// zhes dran pa gso/ gnyis pa ni/ gos me'am nyi ma la bsros la bskon/ sha drod la bcar/ bur chang dron mo blud/ sngar gyi ro dang gnyis gyi bar du bsgrib bo// gsum pa ni/ gtam sgad na bag tsam smra shes pa dang*/ lus rnying pa de gsar pas mi mthong ba'i sar drag shul dang bcas pas (533)bskyar bar bya'o// de lta bu'i lus des mchog bsgrub la gzhan don bya'o// de lta bu'i grong 'jug sbyang bar byed pa la/ steng 'og gi rlung la dbang thob pa dang*// bskyed rim brtan pas bya'i// gzhan gyis 'jug par mi 'gyur ro// de phyir sbyang ba gnyis la 'bad par bya'o// grong 'jug sbrul lpags 'dor byed kyi gdams ngag gi// steng sgo rnam grol chos drug go /bla ma mkha' 'gro'i gsung bzhin du// snya nam grod phug dgon pa ru// rdo rje rgyal mtshan brtse bas bris// mi la ras pas/ ras chung rdo rje grags pa la gtad pa rdzogs so// / rgya rgya rgya/ ༈ /bde mchog snyan brgyud kyi gtum mo dang thabs lam gyi 'khrul 'khor bzhugs so// na mo gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī/ rtsa mdud grol dang gegs sel gnad kyi mchog /lus kyi nad gdon ma lus sel bar byed// sems kyi ye shes ngo bo 'phrod par byed// rdzu 'phrul yon tan ma lus ster bar byed// bde chen thig le'i lus su 'gyur ba'i phyir// rdo rje'i tshig rkang legs par bshad pa'i don// rtsa ba drug la yan lag so dgu yi// snyan brgyud 'khrul 'khor gsal ba'i me long bkod// thog mar rnal 'byor sprul sku'i lus bya zhing*// bdud rtsi bcud kyi rdzas ni lus la byung*/

gsum pa skyabs 'gro bzhi pa sems bskyed bya// yid bzhin nor bu spyi bo'i gtsug gi rgyan// srog rtsol longs sku'i chings ni brtan par bya// chos sku de bzhin nyid ni phrad byas shing*// 'dzam gling rlung gi rkyal ba 'bud par bya// srog rtsol mnan la thur sel gyen la 'then// ro snyoms gar gyi 'khrul 'khor bskor ba ci// bde chen rtsa ba'i 'khor lo rnam drug la// seng ge rtse ba skyil krung bca'// lag gnyis bsnol la rkang la 'dus// gyen la 'then la klod par bya// de yis thig le 'dzin (534)par byed// glang chen 'gying pa'i 'khrul 'khor ni// rkang gnyis bar du mkhyid gang bzhag /lag g.yon steng du lag g.yas gzhag /'phong dang byin mjug lan dgu brdab// thig le gyen la 'dren par byed// rma bya 'phur pa'i 'khrul 'khor ni// lag gnyis rkang pa'i mthe bong bzung*// 'phongs dang rting pa re mos brdung*// thig le lus la khroms par byed// stag mo skyug pa'i 'khrul 'khor ni// skyil krung bar du lag gnyis bcug /ro stod bsnyegs shing skyug tshul dgu// de yis thig le 'dzin par byed// ru sbal bskum pa'i 'khrul 'khor ni// rkang gnyis bar du khru gang gzhag /lag gnyis brla yi nang nas ni// phyir la bton la rkang theb bzung*// thig le gyen la 'dren par byed// bya rgod 'phur ba'i 'khrul 'khor ni// rkang pa 'theng 'gros re mos bya// lag pa phyogs bcur sprug cig 'khrab// de yis thig le khrems par byed// 'khrul 'khor 'di rnams byed pa'i tshe// chu mig gyen bzlog dar chen phyar// rgya mtsho brag gtad ri rab bsnyings// khar bar dag tu seng sbrug bya// ngal gso mnyam bzhag phyag rgya bya// de yis thig le brtan par 'gyur// rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa yi// nad rnams ma lus 'byung mi 'gyur// rtsa mdud rags pa grol par 'gyur// thig le gdon gyis 'dzag pa dang*// nad kyis 'dzag dang rkyen gyis 'dzag

/rang bzhin 'dzag pa gcod par byed// las dang nyams grib ma gtogs pa// thig la mthur rgyug btsan thabs ldog /dmigs pa bla ma'i zhal las dril// nyin re ma chags nyams su blang*// yan lag 'khrul 'khor so dgu la// rgyal mtshan 'khrud pa yan lag bzhi// 'khrud pa ltar bya khyab bar byug /spa lus rtse ba sel bar byed// ri rab 'khrul 'khor rnam bzhi la// sprul mnye (535)mgo bo 'khrud ltar mnye// nyes gnyis gang yin mgo nad sel// zo chun rke mjing g.yas g.yon bskor// gre ba rke mjing nad rnams sel// gso ba khri mon ri rab ni// phyogs bzhir lan grangs gsum gsum brdab// mgo bo'i nad dang sna nad sel// chu mig phyogs bcur ther tshugs blta// mig nad rab rib ma lus sel// 'on long 'gog dang ro mi tshor// sba ba gnyer ma mi 'byung zhing*// mgo bo'i rtsa mdud grol bar byed// de rjes ljon shing 'khrul 'khor bzhi// ri gsum rkang pa mgo lag gsum// shes tshad gyen bsgreng dpung khar len// rtsibs log gzer ba'i nad rnams sel// gru gu brkyang ba khru tshur bcang*// dpung pa g.yas g.yon re mos brdung*// dpung nad mdun rgyab gzer ba sel// dbang po gang ba lag pa gnyis// mda' gzhu 'gengs dang re mos brkyang*// lag pa mi thog na ba dang*// ro stod gzer ba sel bar byed// mthe bong rked pa lag pa g.yas// zhags pa 'phen ltar bskor zhing sprug /g.yon pas rgyab tu khu tshur gsum// de ltar g.yon du'ang shis par bya// lag pa'i rtsa nad tshigs nad sel// sna khrag 'dzag pa sel bar byed// zha rengs nad rnams 'byung mi 'gyur// ljon shing rtsa mdud grol bar byed// stod kyi 'khrul 'khor rnam bzhi la// skar mda' bsnol ba lag pa gnyis// dpung gnyis 'jus la g.yas g.yon gcud// stod smad tsha grang nad rnams sel// mdun rgyab gzer ba sel bar byed// li ri gtud pa lag pa gnyis// re mos 'jus la gyen du brten// 'khrug dang glo mchin nad rnams sel// ri rab gcar la lag pa gnyis// rdo rje bsdams la rtse gcig bsgreng*// nu ma g.yas g.yon rkan la brdab// brang gi dkyil du lan gcig (536)brdab// thur la lan gsum sbrug par bya// mtsher nad rtsibs gzer nad dang ni// ro stod dgang dang na ba sel// gling bu 'bud pa lag pa g.yon// pus mo bkab la lag pa g.yas// dpung steng bkab la thur du bslang*// ro stod g.yas g.yon re mos gcud// glo dang 'khrugs rnams ma lus sel// snying rlung 'og rlung babs pa sel// 'gram 'khrugs skran nad 'byung mi 'gyur// stod kyi rtsa mdud grol bar byed// rked pa'i 'khrul 'khor rnam bzhi la// rgya mtsho dkrugs shing lte ba bskor// ma zhu lte ba'i nad rnams sel// sgeg mo dgye ba kag lang la// lag gnyis rgyab tu shes tshad brkyang*// rked pa dgye log shes tshad bya// mkhal nad dbyi mig gzer ba sel// sa bla mnan pa rkang gnyis bsnol// lag gnyis bsnol la mthe bong bzung*// gyen du 'then la lhod kyis klod// skran dang dmu chu'i nad rnams dang*// chu kha snyir dang bsdams pa sel// sha rkyang sbyar ba 'dzub mo bsnol// spyi gtsug bteg nas lte bar brdab// lto bar thal mos nyed par bya// skran dang dmu chu rked pa'i nad// tsha grang srin nad ma lus sel// rked pa'i rtsa mdud grol bar byed// smad kyi 'khrul 'khor rnam bzhi las// rdo rje 'gros ni lag pa gnyis// sgyid khung nang du bsnol la 'khra// pangs la log gnyis mdun du bzhag

/stod 'tshangs rlung gi nad rnams dang*// drag po'i srog 'dzin rengs ba sel// chu srin brkyang bskum lag pa gnyis// brla yi phyi nas re mos dkyus// rkang pa re mos sprug par bya// lus kun na dang gyogs po dang*// rkang nad tshigs nad ma lus sel// sbal 'gros 'phags cing gab gab 'gros// chu ser skya rbab skem bar byed// gcig ni rdo rje skyil krung yin// smad kyi nad rnams sel bar byed// rags dang phra ba'i rtsa mdud grol// thig le bu ga dgu rnams nas// 'dzag srung 'khrul 'khor gnad kyi mchog /tshe ring yon tan bsam mi khyab// rjes la bsngo (537)ba'i rgyas 'debs bya// nyin re ma chag nyams su blang*// 'di ni lag len mdor bsdus yin// rlung gegs sel ba'i 'khrul 'khor dang*// gtum mo'i 'khrul 'khor bcu gcig dang*// seng ge rnam grol gzhan nas shes// nā ro paṇa chen phyag len ltar// kho bo mar pa lo tsā yis// snod ldan don du yi ger bkod// snyan brgyud 'chal du mi 'jug cing*// nyams khrid rdzogs par ma thob par// gal te de nyid bsten gyur na// nag po che dang za byed kyi// mkha' 'gro rnams kyis mgo bo khos// mchog thun mong lo'am tshe 'dir ster bar byed pa 'khrul 'khor gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba rdzogs so// maṇ+ḍal gser zho re med par mi gnang bar bla ma mkha' 'gro'i bka' rgya yod/ ༈ na mo gu ru/ gtum mo'i 'khrul 'khor bco brgyad la// lag len gnad zab yi ger bkod// rlung skyon sbyor ba'i 'khrul 'khor gcig /lus gnad sdod pa'i 'khrul 'khor bzhi// drod btsan thabs 'bebs pa'i 'khrul 'khor gnyis// bying rgod sel ba'i 'khrul 'khor gnyis// mtshan mo nyal ba'i 'khrul 'khor gcig /'gro ba'i dus kyi 'khrul 'khor gnyis// gegs sel gnad kyi 'khrul 'khor gnyis// thig le 'dren pa'i 'khrul 'khor bzhi// dril bas rkang grangs bco brgyad las// rlung skyon sbyong ba'i 'khrul 'khor ni// mdun bsnol 'khor lo ltar bskor ba// rkang pa rdo rje skyil krung bca'// lag pa mthe bong bsnol byas la// srin lag mnan la khu tshur sbyar// gcu zhing gcu zhing lan dgu ru// rlung ni 'jam la ring bar bus// de yis rlung skyon sel bar byed// sdod pa'i 'khrul 'khor rnam bzhi la/

skyil krung te (538)lo'i chos bdun te// rnam snang chos bdun zhes kyang bya// rkang pa rdo rje skyil krung bca'// drod ni shugs la skye ba yin// lag gnyis lte 'og sor bzhi ru// mnyam gzhag phyag rgya dam du bca'// rtsa kha 'byed cing bde ba skye// sgal tshing drang por bsrangs pa yis// rlung rnams rang sar tshud pa yin// mgrin pa lcags kyu lta bur dgug /snying rtse gyen log mi rtog skye// dpung pa rgod gshog bzhin du brkyang*// dgos pa rlung nad chung ba yin// mig ni sna yi rtse mor blta// dmigs pa dag ni gsal ba yin// lus sems li ri ltar du bsgrim// bde drod myur du skye ba yin// rgya mdud ching ge 'khrul 'khor ni// gnad rnams sngar da 'dra ba la// rkang bsnol tsog pus pus 'khyud bzhugs// yon tan gong dang 'dra ba la// 'di ni khyad par drod skye 'gyur// ljon shing bsnol ba'i 'khrul 'khor na// rkang pa re mig bzhi du bsnol// lag pa mkhrig ma'i mtshams nas bsdam// pus mo gnyis ni bkab pa yis// grang ba'i nad rnams 'phral du 'joms// sku gsum bsnol ba'i 'khrul 'khor ni// rkang pa g.yon pa'i bol gong steng*// g.yas pa'i rgyu ma khug bzhag la// pus mo gnyis la 'khyud pas bsdam// rtsa rnams yo ba bsrang ba dang*// rlung rnams srog tu tshud pa yin// 'khrul 'khor bzhi po bsdoms pa la// sdod pa'i 'khrul 'khor zhes bya'o// rgya mdud chings ni drod myur te// drod btsan thabs 'bebs pa'i 'khrul 'khor la// gong gi 'khrul 'khor drug chings ni// rkang pa re mig bzhin du bsnol// lag gnyis brla yi dkyil nas bsnol// rkang mtheb gnyis bzung g.yas g.yon bskor// drod tshan me ltar 'bar ba dang*// ma zhu skran nad thal ba glog /gangs lag cer nyal byas kyang (539)tshugs// stobs chen seng ge lta bur 'gyur// sbrul dang bya khyung gnad la bor// mthe bong bzhi ni sa la btsug

/mgo bo pus mo'i bar du bcug /lus kyis 'gul skyod ci shes bya// yon tan gong dang 'dra ba la// chu kha snyi ga sdom par byed// bying rgod sel ba'i 'khrul 'khor ni// bying na bya rgod mkha' la 'phur// lag gnyis gdengs pa 'phag cing sprug /nam mkha'i dkyil du thig le bsgom// yang yang rlung 'bud phaṭa kyis bsing*// bying rmug rig pa nyog ba sel// rgod na shes pa bum par gzung*// lag gnyis bsnol la pus steng bzhag /ri rab lag pa'i logs la sbyar// rkang mthil 'od kyi thig le bsgom// rnam rtog 'phro zhing rgod pa sel// mtshan mo nyal ba'i 'khrul 'khor ni// spyang mo nyal ba zhes bya ste// lag g.yas mkhal ma'i steng du dgab// pus brang sprad la g.yon pas bsdom// bde drod rab tu 'bar ba dang*// nub gos ras kyis chog par 'gyur// 'gro ba'i dus kyi 'khrul 'khor ni// mkhar ltar bab pa zhes bya ba// gan rkyal byas la 'phra zhing sprug /chu ser rang sar 'grim par byed// thig le khrems par the tshom med// lus ni lhun stug mdzes par 'gyur// ne le res 'jog 'khrul 'khor ni// thur sel drag po ma brjed bzung*// rlung gi lha mo gshogs pa can// gnyis kyis mchan 'og 'degs par bsam// rkang 'og rlung gi 'khor lo ni// gzhu yi dbyibs can mchog ma nas// ba dan 'ur 'ur bskyod par bsam// lag gnyis khu tshur bcangs pa dang*// lag g.yas rkang g.yon gdong la bor// lag g.yon nang g.yon rting la zor// mi gcig nyi bdun phyin pa'i sar// nyi ma gcig la speb par 'gyur// (540)gegs sel gnad kyi 'khrul 'khor ni// seng ge rtsal sprug zhes bya ba// skyil krung pus steng lag gnyis bzhag /lus kyis god sbag yang yang bya// rlung gzhi la thig le khrims par de// ro stod seng chen bzhin du 'gyur// seng ge rnam rol 'khrul 'khor ni// lag pa'i sor mos kha sna dang*// mig dang sna bug bkag byas la// ro stod 'khor lo ltar du bskor// rtsa rlung thig le'i gegs sel zhing*// dwangs ma 'khor lo bzhi la 'grems// 'pho ba byed na gnad kyi mchog

/thig le 'dren pa'i 'khrul 'khor la// ri rab phul ba zhes bya ba// rkang pa rdo rje skyil krung bca'// mthe bong gnyis pos srin lag mnan// khu tshur bcangs la brla khud gzugs// hūm̐ ring hūm̐ thung nyer gcig brjod// thig le 'dzag bsrung gyen du 'dren// khra yi bzhad tshul zhes bya ba// lag gnyis khu tshur steng bcas nas// rkang pa rdo rje skyil krung bca'// dbugs hūm̐ gis ni rngub par bya// de rjes yi dwags 'khrul 'khor ni// rkang pa'i mthil ni sprad byas la// langs la pus mo lag pas dgag /hika ka hika ni drag tu brjod// seng ge gan log sbyor ba ni// rkang pa rdo rje skyil krung bca'// lag gnyis skyil krung bar du bcug /hika ka hika ka drag tu brjod// rjes la seng ge rtsal sprug bya// de rjes mnyam gzhag ngang du klod// 'khrul 'khor bzhi po byed pa'i tshe// chu mig gyen ldog dar chen phyar// rgya mtsho brag gtad ri rab bsnyengs// 'og rlung drangs la gling bzhi bsdu// 'khrul 'khor 'di la brtson gyur na// sba ba sbubs nub thig le 'ching*// rags dang phra ba'i rtsa bdud grol// lus ni bkrag dang gzi mdangs ldan// tshe ring rgas pa spang bar 'gyur// (541)rtsa nub gnyer ma mi 'byung zhing*// gzhon nu mdzes ldan lhun stug 'gyur// nang rtags mkha' 'gro dam can 'du// 'khrul 'khor re res glo bur du byed pa'i gnad// gtum mo'i 'khrul 'khor bco brgyad pa zhes bya bsnyan brgyud yid bzhin nor bu'i gdams pa rdzogs so/// zab bo// zab bo// bka' rgya/// /
